 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Grid is partitioned by a single-color separator row/column. Each
    # resulting tile is reduced to a marker when it contains multiple marks.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            colors = set(vals)
            colors.discard(sep)
            base = max(colors, key=lambda v: vals.count(v))
            marked = [v for v in colors if v != base]
            mark = marked[0] if marked else base
            row.append(1 if vals.count(mark) > 1 else base)

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    # A full-width/full-height separator color partitions the grid into tiles.
    sep = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rb) - 1):
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(cb) - 1):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[ri] + 1, rb[ri + 1])
                    for c in range(cb[ci] + 1, cb[ci + 1])]
            freq = {}
            for v in vals:
                if v != sep:
                    freq[v] = freq.get(v, 0) + 1
            base = max(freq, key=freq.get)
            marker = next((v for v in freq if v != base), None)
            row_out.append(1 if marker is not None and freq[marker] >= 2 else base)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [[2,2,4,9,2],[9,9,4,9,2],[4,4,4,4,4],[9,2,4,2,2],[2,2,4,2,9],[4,4,4,4,4],[2,9,4,2,2],[9,2,4,9,2]]
